ui_emptyTitle.message: What should I do in Zen?

ui_grantNote.message: Answer in the Claude in Zen window that opened: Allow this folder, or Deny. Allowing covers the folder and its subfolders until you remove it in Profile, Permissions. Army workers never look there.

ui_attachTitle.message: Add files: Word, PDF, images, slides, sheets… You can also paste or drop them here.

ui_uploadHint.message: or paste, or drop them in

ui_modelGroupLabel.message: Model: Speed or Quality, with Speed Plus (in Speed) or the army (in Quality) on the left

ui_armyBtnTitle.message: Army: Opus 5.5 leads up to five Haiku 5.5 workers in background tabs. Click for details.

ui_plusTitle.message: Speed Plus: Haiku 5.5 at max effort. Close to Opus quality, still light on usage. Click to turn it on or off.

ui_modeTitle.message: Click to switch between Speed (Haiku 5.5, high effort) and Quality (Opus 5.5, high effort).

ui_armyIntro.message: Opus 5.5 leads (high effort, or max with the switch below). For jobs that need several pages, it sends up to five Haiku 5.5 workers (high effort), each in its own background tab. They read, click and type there with your logins. Your current tab stays where it is.

ui_armyNever.message: They never type passwords, 2FA codes or payment details. Stop ends every worker and closes their tabs.

ui_armyCost.message: A run uses far more of your plan than a normal reply.

ui_histConfirm.message: Delete every saved chat of this account? This cannot be undone.

ui_signedOutText.message: Uses the claude.ai session already open in Zen. Sign in to claude.ai in a normal tab first, then click below. Zen remembers it after that, until you sign out here or on claude.ai.

ui_signOutNote.message: Signing out here leaves claude.ai itself signed in.

ui_loginNote.message: A sign-in window is open. Pick the Claude account there and click Authorize. This list updates when you are done.

ui_accountsNote.message: Each account keeps its own chats. The chat uses the one marked In use.

ui_trustedNote.message: Claude acts on any site without asking. Pages can try to steer it.

ui_siteListLabel.message: Sites Allow or Block applies to

ui_wallNote.message: Cards keep their own colour. The text on the page turns black or white to suit the wallpaper. Kept in this browser only.

ui_macrosNote.message: A saved prompt you send with

ui_macrosNoteEnd.message: . Army tasks (one per line) send it in Quality with the army on. A macro with sites can also run on a timer while the browser is open: it only reads those sites, and the result lands in History under Scheduled.

ui_macroSitesPh.message: Sites to read when scheduled, e.g. news.example

ui_modsNote.message: Small add-ons for this panel, kept in

ui_modsNoteEnd.message: . A mod that throws is stopped and shown here, and the rest keep running. Switch changes take effect after Reload panel.

ui_toolsIntro.message: Extra tools the chat can use. The essentials (vidIQ, Caveman) are on; everything else stays off until you switch it on. Anything that runs programs on this PC asks first in the Claude in Zen window, and shells like Desktop Commander are never on.

ui_toolsCheckTitle.message: Start every tool once to see which ones answer, and list your claude.ai connectors

ui_toolHeaderPh.message: Header, if it needs one: Authorization: Bearer …

ui_pluginSourcePh.message: Marketplace, if it is new: owner/repo or https://…

ui_pluginsNote.message: Plugins and connectors you add on claude.ai appear here by themselves (press check).

ui_panelPlace.message: The panel docks on the right. Open and close it with the toolbar button or

ui_panelPlaceEnd.message: . Zen's title bar above the panel is hidden, so the panel has no header menu. Drag the sidebar's inner edge to make it wider.

main_filesOff.message: Off. Claude has no file access. Type a full folder path, then turn it on.

main_filesRead.message: On: Claude can read and search files in this folder only. No changes, no shell.
